annotations.title: What the owner says about this site

description: What the site’s owner wrote about it in SEO › Settings: what the site is and who it is for (overview), where it sells (market), what the owner is pushing for right now (goal), why someone picks it over the alternatives (positioning), how to write for it (writing: tone, words to avoid, topics that are off-limits) and the sites it competes with (rivals). Read it before you give advice or write copy, so the answer fits this business. A field the owner left empty is null and is named in empty; saved is false when nothing was ever saved, and then say so and work from the measured reads. These are the owner’s own words, not measurements: Convertlyft filled none of them in and checked none of them, and a figure inside one is the owner’s claim, never a count from this site. cvl_check_claim cannot check a number against this answer. The owner changes it on that screen; cvl_set_site_context changes it for them, only after they agreed to a preview.
